name: hu-cross-border
description: Hub skill for crossing the Hungarian border in tax year 2026. Covers individual tax residence under Szja tv. 3. § 2. (citizenship, EEA nationals present 183 days, long-term residence permits, then permanent home, centre of vital interests and habitual abode); non-residents taxed only on Hungarian-source income; the payer's 15% withholding on dividends, interest and royalties paid to foreign individuals and the treaty rate at source with a residence certificate and beneficial owner statement (Szja tv. 7. számú melléklet); no withholding on payments to foreign companies; the foreign tax credit (Szja tv. 32. §, 90%) and treaty exemption; the corporate exit tax with five instalments for EU and EEA moves (Tao. tv. 16/A. §); A1 certificates; penalties. Trigger phrases: külföldi illetőségű, belföldi illetőség, kettős adóztatás, illetőségigazolás, exit tax Hungary, moving to Hungary, leaving Hungary, non-resident dividend Hungary. Out of scope: hu-corporate-tax, hu-transfer-pricing, hu-income-
